desktop.note: Reviewed the five current paired showcase captures at desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile and narrow-mobile, plus all nine current authenticated normal-state matrix screenshots across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. The Japanese rendering preserves the source’s restrained white field, black type, centered Basalt mark, rating control and information hierarchy; the narrow layouts keep the mark and long example within the viewport. The standardized JP fixture replaces upstream showcase prose and site shell, so those localized content differences remain a warning rather than pixel-parity evidence.
